# Ruben Svanerud

> Filmmaker and photographer based in Uppsala and Stockholm, Sweden. Shoots and edits his own work: ski films, YouTube productions, underwater series and boxing.

## Projects

- [For the Love of Ski](projects/for-the-love-of-ski.html): Short film, 2026, 04:03. A short film cut from a season of skiing with friends. It was also Ruben's entry to Alpingaraget's video competition Vinter Edit 2026.
- [Betting Everything on Popcorn](projects/betting-everything-on-popcorn.html): YouTube episode, Milan, Italy, 2026, 11:00. Mr. Popcorn came to Ruben with an idea for a YouTube series. Episode one goes to Italy to look at the machine that could start his popcorn company. Ruben filmed and edited it in Milan, and calls it his favourite work yet.
- [A Different Planet](projects/a-different-planet.html): Underwater photo & film, 2026. An underwater series: reefs, a sunken aircraft and a feeding sea turtle, published as photographs and short clips.
- [Kebnekaise](projects/kebnekaise.html): Hiking film & photo, Kebnekaise, Sweden, 2026. A summer hike in Kebnekaise with friends, cut into a short film. The photograph of the climb is, in Ruben's words, one of his favourites from the summer.
- [EM26 Is Next](projects/em26-is-next.html): Boxing, behind the scenes, Trädgården, 2026. Ruben films the boxer Erwa at ringside and backstage, from fight night at Trädgården toward the European Championships, EM26. The films are published on Erwa’s and Ruben’s Instagram.
